title: Odile and the Ember
author: F. M. Almeida
blurb: Noor Sandoval, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent twenty years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
